support.notes: Exact Steam pin of the public head observed 2026-10-06 (native Linux dedicated server, engine CL 378787; depot 443032 manifest 3253120066949448972). The shipped connector is the native library libtakaro-conan-native.so (LD_PRELOAD into the server): it holds the Takaro connection itself, needs no RCON and no mod, and hooks this build (GNU build-id 8d5382c18fa73ab61bee077e65d3acc427825502, games/conan-exiles/native/core/pins/pins.json) and the previous 25639945; on any other build it connects, reports the unknown build and refuses every action. The three anchors kept their signatures and moved (+0x13000 code, +0x35100 data); the reflection diff of a live probe dump is clean (only runtime-resolved offsets moved). It is built in its own pinned buster toolchain (games/conan-exiles/native/platform/linux/Dockerfile.build), which compiles the two build.deps below from the same SHA-256-checked archives; this record's build toolchain image is not used by the Linux build and is kept because the schema requires one. A hosted runner cannot boot the 4.3 GB server, so release verification is contract level.

notes: The dedicated server is a self-contained UE5 Linux build that needs only glibc/libstdc++, so it runs in the pinned Node image recorded as the runtime; the rig and the verifier start it by command (ConanSandboxServer.sh). The Steamworks redist depot 1006 is pinned because the proven install carried it; it is not watched (Valve's depot).
